  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    BodyState
    What a fighter knows about its own body at one moment, however that body is driven: the player's own character on the client, or a fake player on the server.
    ClientSprint
    Sprinting as a real game client keeps it, and what the server gets to hear of it.
    Delay<T>
    Hands things on a fixed number of ticks late: what one fighter gets to know of the other on a server, where everything has gone through the network first.
    LagLink<T>
    What comes over a connection to a server: everything a set number of ticks late, and over one that stutters, now and then nothing at all for a few ticks and then all of it at once.
    RemoteView
    Another player as a game client shows it.
    SessionClock
    Slow-changing values of a training session that the observation needs; owned and updated by the session.
    StepFacts
    Ground truth about one agent step, gathered by the mod.
    TakenStreak
    The opponent's combo as a fighter can count it itself: the hits it has taken in a row without landing one in between.
